rootCause: Scene Grass/TreeLeave materials save AlphaThreshold=0. clip(0-0) retains fully transparent texels; A2C hides this only in multisampled color targets. Earlier threshold=0.5 test did not represent the scene and did not close this issue.
correction: All ten leaf/grass ordinary+instance Forward, FoliageDepth, ShadowCaster and FoliageShadow clip sites first reject alpha=0, then preserve the original positive-alpha threshold comparison. Nature Renderer procedural variants share these fragments. Prior three shadow AlphaToMask Off states retained. No material or texture migration.

zeroThresholdRegression.method: Actual shader draws of a four-texel point-filtered RGBA texture, alpha 0,0.25,0.75,1, thresholds 0 and 0.5, sample counts 1 and 4. Regular and instance Forward/Shadow plus Grass Nature Renderer compressed procedural variants. Clear color is magenta. No production normal-frame readback added.
